2024 Access to Medicine Index

description.narrative: In November 2024, the 2024 ATM Index was published featuring most current insights into industry trends, key findings, best practices, company rankings and individual company report cards, including the big three diabetes care companies. The three key findings were: 1. Pharma companies are taking steps to address access in low-income countries, but significant gaps remain. 2. Patients in low- and middle-income countries largely left out of clinical trials, limiting access to new treatments. 3. Efforts to ramp up wider local availability of medicines through voluntary licensing and technology transfers are limited.

2024 Access to Medicine Index Special Report on Patient Reach

description.narrative: In September 2024, the ATM Foundation published the ATM Index Special Report on Patient Reach. The report emphasised strategies for pharmaceutical companies to improve access to their products for underserved populations. As part of the Methodology for the 2024 Access to Medicine Index, the ATM Foundation introduced a standalone indicator for tracking and measuring patient reach. Based on the 2024 ATM Index's data collection process, the team compiled initial insights into the approaches companies use to measure patient reach, delving into companies’ methodologies, underlying assumptions, and the limitations of these approaches. The report highlights the necessity for establishing clear goals and metrics to measure patient reach and calls for enhanced data tracking to better assess healthcare disparities.

description.narrative: On 24 September 2024, alongside the 79th United Nations General Assembly in New York, the Access to Medicine Foundation and AXA Investment Managers co-hosted a high-level event on enhancing access to medicines and advancing global health equity. The event explored how integrating access frameworks into business strategies can drive healthcare equity on a global scale. Key takeaways from the event are detailed in a meeting report.
